about: The reading every multisig signer gets, on every platform (r8-1, r8-2, r8-5): multisig_rules `review.reading {chainId, safe, tx, tokenFacts?}` -> {reading, concerns, anyway, refused}. The same `reading` is MultisigReview.reading; the same concerns are in MultisigReview.concerns. A native parity test calls multisig_link_call("review.reading", args) and compares with expect. Regenerate expects: VELA_WRITE_READING_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p vela-core --features crux the_reading_vectors_hold.

cases.name: Arc's USDC ERC-20 transfer of 10000 base units: 0.01 USDC, from the registry (r8-2, r8-20)
a token nobody read: the amount raw, decimals unknown, never 18 assumed (r8-2)
the same token with its contract's answer: 6 decimals, its symbol
the network's coin: 1.5 USDC at 18 decimals
approve(spender, 2^256-1) of Arc's USDC: unlimited, a danger, approve anyway (r8-1)
approve(spender, 2^256-1) of an unread token: still unlimited (no token facts needed)
approve(spender, 5 USDC): an allowance, plain
increaseAllowance by 2^256-1: unlimited
decreaseAllowance: it shrinks, never unlimited
an on-chain EIP-2612 permit for 2^256-1: unlimited
DAI's permit, allowed: all of it
Permit2 approve(token, spender, 2^160-1, expiration): unlimited
setApprovalForAll(operator, true): every token of the collection
transferFrom(from, to, 1 USDC)
a call nobody reads: blind, approve anyway
tokens sent to the token's own contract: lost, a danger
a batch: a transfer and an unlimited approve, each leg read
a batch whose leg calls multiSend of two transfers (r8 #9): every leg of every level, nested, approve anyway (r8-5)
multiSend called four deep: not read, nothing signed (r8-5)
a delegatecall to an unknown contract (Bybit): refused, nothing read
a member change: the multisig's own, no calls read
